name: Ancient City of Sigiriya
description: Rising about 180 metres above the jungle in central Sri Lanka, Sigiriya, or Lion Rock, is a granite pillar that King Kassapa I turned into a fortress capital in the 5th century. Visitors climb staircases and galleries, passing a gateway once shaped like a giant lion, to reach the ruined palace on the summit. After his death, monks used the site until the 14th century.
